spiritual_reading:
# The Wheel Before the King of Honour — Translated into the Spiritual Sense

---

** ¶1:** There exists a total divine order in the presence of the Divine Good that governs from the in most celestial degree. This order holds the deep est origin of every dominant evil love, both in the interior and exterior regions of the mind , in a severe and unbreakable restra int. The entire purpose of the Divine Good operating through governance is invested in this order. Likewise , all the host ility and opposition of evil loves established across the planes of the external mind is caught and held fast within it .

**¶2:** This order is radiant with the spl endor of divine truth, arranged in perfect spiritual form and of sur passing beauty. Within it are twelve complete tru ths of faith. Each truth of faith distingu ishes and separates every established plane of the external mind from the dominant loves that inhab it it . Should any evil love seek to break free from this divine arrangement , it is restrained by truth. Should any evil love attempt de ception within its constraint , the de ception becomes immediately manifest and exposed within this order. All general states of spiritual life , all particular knowledges of good and truth, and the principal governing love over every force in the mind — all exist within this order and are discer ned through it, in the presence of the Divine Good.

**¶ 3:** The twelfth and completing truth within this order consists of five illumin ated sensory faculties of the interior person , which are interwoven and con joined throughout the entire sphere of the natural mind. Every state in which these faculties are constrained, and every state in which they are given freedom , is made manifest through this divine order. For the deep est origin of all established planes of the external mind, above and below, together with that of their dominant loves, is held capt ive and secured within it .

**¶4:** The faculty of spiritual perception is set in continuous and unw avering orientation toward the Divine Good governing all things, so that holy a we proce eding from divine authority may take hold of every force belonging to the com mingled state — where good and evil remain intertwined — and so that the deep est origin of these forces is fixed there , and they cannot free themselves from the constraint that divine order imp oses upon them.

**¶ 5:** This divine order is , in this respect, like a connected series of truths set before the principal guardian of spiritual life: when evil loves are brought before this linked chain of truths, they are bound .

**¶6:** So it is for all dominant evil loves established in the planes of the external mind, and for every force within the natural sphere: should they seek to break free, they are recognized and laid bare by this divine order. For this order is like a great mirror of spiritual discernment — the capacity to distinguish all interior states and qualities resides within it.

---

* A note on "the five shining men" ( ¶3 ): * This image partially res ists direct translation. My best reading is that "five" corresponds to what is sens ory and natural in the person — here illumin ated from within — and "men " sign ifies intellectual faculties viv ified by truth . Together they represent the regener ated sens ory understanding int erwoven through the whole external mind , serving as the final seal or completing contain ment by which the divine order gov erns the natural degree from within .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: about the wheel that exists in front [of the King of Honour who dwells in] the seventh firmament [, and constrains in it], the root of the rulers above and below in a great and cruel fetter; as the entire will of the great King of Honour is placed in [it]. Also, their entire enmity, which is in the firmaments, is [caught] and ensnared in it.

It exists in a blaze of splendour [with] ornamentation and great beauty. Now, there are twelve seals in it. The seal between i[s] every firmament and the rulers who are there[. And the bonds of all the powers] are in it; for should one of them wish to escape, he will be bound [by the seal]. If he should wish to cause a trick in his bond[, the trick will be] apparent and known in [that] wheel [at once]. The spheres and stars and [the] leader of all the powers exist there, and can be known by it, in front of the King of Honour.

The twelf[t]h seal that is in it is its five shining men that are conjoined and enmeshed through the entire zone; because every place where they are cramped, and every place where they have space, is displayed by that wheel. For the root of all the firmaments above and below, and that of their rulers, is ensnared and fixed in it.

The observation [of that wheel] is set right at all times opposite the great King o[f Honour who rules over all,] so that fear, wh[ich proceeds from him,] will assume all the powers of mixture[, and keep] their root affixed there, so that they cannot make an esc[a]pe from the fetter of their bond.
That wheel rese[m]bles, in this respect, a chain in front of the chief guard, for when [the rulers are placed] in th[ose bonds, they are held fast] in the [great cha]in.

This is also the case for all the rulers who are in the firmaments, and every power of the zone: If they should wish to escape, they shall be recognised and revealed by that wheel. [As] the wheel is like a great mirror, for [the di]scrimination of all things [and every power is] in it.
